subtitles.en: How much did you and your parents, your family, discuss finances before you made the decision to come to purchase?

subtitles.en: school at all with FAFSA and TAP. Did you have to take out any loans to attend school?

subtitles.en: For my first year I did, but once I became an RA, I didn't have to take out any more loans, so now I've been paying them back.
subtitles.zh: 我很幸运，父母愿意为我贷款，我自己也承担了一些债务，但他们愿意尽可能多地存钱。

subtitles.en: I'm fortunate enough that my parents were willing to take out loans for me, and I also am going into a little bit of debt, but they were willing to set aside
subtitles.zh: 我获得了Excelsior奖学金，但毕业后必须留在纽约，否则就得偿还贷款。

subtitles.en: like as much money as possible. I got the Excelsior scholarship, so if I meaning after I graduate I have to stay in New York otherwise I'll have to pay the loan back.
subtitles.zh: 那笔贷款是多少？我想大概是5000美元。

subtitles.en: And how much is that loan? I think it's like $5,000.
subtitles.zh: 州外学费确实很高，所以我申请了一些学生贷款，还自己筹办了一场演出，通过演出筹钱来上大学。

subtitles.en: Out-of-state tuition is definitely a lot, so I took out some student loans and was able to do that pretty easily, and I also put on my own fundraising show, like I produced my own show to raise money
subtitles.zh: 你通过那场演出筹了多少钱？大约3500美元。

subtitles.en: to come to college, so yeah, how much did you raise from that? About $3,500, yeah.
subtitles.zh: 你打算定期这样做吗？是的，我计划每年都在家乡举办，因为很成功，这也能帮我建立自己的奖学金基金。

subtitles.en: Is this something you're going to be doing regularly, you think? Yeah, I'm planning actually on doing it every year in my hometown since it was so successful, so it kind of helps me build my own scholarship fund a little bit.
subtitles.zh: 你觉得你会经常这样做吗？是的，我计划每年都在家乡做，因为效果很好，这也能帮我积累一点自己的奖学金基金。

clip_research.source_claim: I got the Excelsior scholarship, so if I meaning after I graduate I have to stay in New York otherwise I'll have to pay the loan back.
clip_research.public_baseline: The Excelsior Scholarship requires recipients to reside in New York State for the number of years they received the scholarship, but it is a grant, not a loan; the student's statement about 'pay the loan back' may be a misunderstanding or refer to other loans.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The student describes the Excelsior Scholarship as having a loan repayment condition, but public sources indicate it is a scholarship with a residency requirement, not a loan.

evidence.fact: Student states Excelsior scholarship requires staying in New York after graduation or paying back the loan.

evidence.query: Excelsior Scholarship New York State requirements stay in New York after graduation
evidence.fact: Excelsior Scholarship requires recipients to work and live in New York State after graduation for the same number of years as received, but it is a scholarship, not a loan.

forbidden_claims: The Excelsior Scholarship is a loan.
The student is dishonest about the scholarship.

notes: The student's description of the Excelsior Scholarship as a loan is inaccurate; it is a scholarship with a residency requirement. This discrepancy could be highlighted in the title

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
